paite: Pathian aw, na vaihawmnate kumpipa kiang ah pia inla, na diktatna kumpipa tapa kiang ah pia in.
heading: Solomon La / Kumpipa Thumna
english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

paite: Na mite dikna in vai ahawmsak ding a, na mi gentheite vaihawmna dik in vai ahawmsak ding hi.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

paite: Tang lian leh mual neute'n diktatna in mite kiang ah khamuanna ahon tun ding uhi.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

paite: Ama'n mi lak a gentheite vai ahawmsak ding a, tagah tate ahondam ding a, nuaisiahtu bel ahihzan ding hi.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

paite: Tung a ni leh kha om sung teng, suan om sung teng in leng akikou ding uhi.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

paite: Amah loupa gawitan tung a vuah kia bang in ake ding a; lei vak vuahtui bang mai in.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

paite: Adam lai un midiktat ahampha ding uh, khapi om nawn louh dong in khamuanna thupi toh akhang ding uhi.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

paite: Ama'n tuipi a pan a tuipi dang pha in, luipi a pan kawlmong pha in thu anei ding.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

paite: Gamdai a omte ama ah akun ding ua, amelmate'n leng leivui aliak ding uhi.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

paite: Tarshish gam leh tuikulh gam kumpipate'n kipahman ahon tawi ding ua; Sheba leh Seba gam Kumpipate'n thilpiakte ahon lan ding uhi.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

paite: Ahi, kumpipa tengteng ama ah abokkhup ding ua, nam chih teng in a-nna asem ding uhi.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

paite: Genthei in asap chiang in ama'n ahumbit ding a, mitagah, panpihpa nei lou leng ahumbit ding hi.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

paite: Migenthei leh tagahte ahehpih ding a, tagahte hinna ahondam ding hi.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

paite: Ahinna uh nuaisiahna leh hiamgamna lak a kipan atan ding a, asisan uh amah ngaihdan in manphatak ahi ding hi.
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

paite: Huan ahing ding a; Sheba gam dangka-eng a kipan a piak ahi ding a, mite'n amah athumsak gige ding ua; niteng in phat in a-om ding hi.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

paite: Lei ah, mualvum peuh ah, buh tampi a-om ding a; avui Lebanon bang in aling suausuau ding a, khua a mite bel loupa bang in apha lihliah ding uhi.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

paite: Amin tangtawn in a-omden ding a; amin nisa a-om sung in tatlak lou in a-om zel ding a; mite amah ah vualzawl in a-om ding ua; nam chihte'n amah hampha achi ding uh.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

paite: TOUPA Pathian, Israel' Pathian phat in om hen, amah kia in thillamdang ahih zel a.
english: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

paite: Amin thupitak tangtawn in phat in leng om henla; leitung pumpi leng athupina a hihdim in om hen. Amen, Amen.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

paite: Jesse tapa David thumnate abeita hi.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
